models.name: Gemini 3.8 Flash
models.description: Google's most intelligent Flash model, engineered for long-horizon software engineering, autonomous agents, and complex enterprise workflows

changelog.description: Gemini 3.8 Flash released to general availability in the Gemini API as the recommended model for new projects
API pricing set at $0.75 per 1M input tokens and $3.75 per 1M output tokens through December 31, 2026, rising to $1.50 and $7.50 from January 1, 2027
Gemini 3.8 Live and Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking audio-to-audio models released for the Live API
Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS released to general availability with voice design, voice replication, and a Voices endpoint

models.name: Gemini 3.7 Flash
models.description: High-speed Flash model built for everyday coding, agentic tool use, and reliable multi-step execution

changelog.description: Gemini 3.7 Flash released to general availability with substantial improvements in software engineering, web development, and agentic workflows
Introductory API pricing set at $0.75 per 1M input tokens and $3.75 per 1M output tokens through December 31, 2026
Agentic video understanding added for Gemini 3.7 Flash, 3.6 Flash, and 3.5 Flash-Lite, using up to 88% fewer tokens on long-form video

models.name: Gemini 3.6 Flash
models.description: Flash model with improved token efficiency and code/agentic planning at a lower price point than Gemini 3.5 Flash

changelog.description: Gemini 3.6 Flash released to general availability, addressing developer feedback on output verbosity
API pricing set at $0.75 per 1M input tokens and $3.75 per 1M output tokens through December 31, 2026, half the price of Gemini 3.5 Flash
The temperature, top_p, and top_k sampling parameters were deprecated for the latest Gemini models

models.name: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite
models.description: Low-latency, cost-efficient model optimized for high-volume agentic subtasks, translation, and simple data processing

changelog.description: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite released to general availability as a high-volume subagent option
API pricing set at $0.30 per 1M input tokens and $2.50 per 1M output tokens

models.name: Gemini 3.5 Flash
models.description: Earlier Flash model built for speed and foundational performance across routine, high-throughput workloads

changelog.description: Gemini 3.5 Flash released for Gemini API and Vertex AI with updated multimodal and reasoning performance
API pricing listed at $1.50 per 1M input tokens and $9.00 per 1M output tokens
Computer Use tool launched in public preview for Gemini 3.5 Flash with browser, mobile, and desktop environments
Google confirmed Gemini 3.5 Pro is still not ready and said it has started pretraining Gemini 4 as its next flagship
